public_rationale: Under the ordinary minimum reading of marketable, public evidence existed: OpenAI’s April 24 update describes an operating research agent available through paid subscriptions. Operator had also launched as a paid subscription feature earlier that year. This contradicts the broad absence-of-product assertion. It does not establish that either product was ready for mass-market adoption or $3 billion in sales.
limitations: The result depends on reading marketable as commercially offered, rather than mature enough for the scale discussed elsewhere.
Deep research qualifies under a broad, functional definition of agent; a narrower browser-action-only definition would require separate assessment.
Product availability does not establish customer satisfaction or standalone agent revenue.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: As of nearly May 2025, Zitron says he sees no evidence that OpenAI has a marketable agent product.

statement.excerpt: I want to be really, really clear: we are nearly in May 2025, and I see no evidence that OpenAI even has a marketable agent product, let alone one that will make it three billion god damn dollars in the next six or seven months.

from_speaker: OpenAI even has a marketable agent product
our_interpretation: Assess the public-evidence assertion, not Zitron’s private awareness.
The ordinary minimum meaning of marketable is a working agent capability offered to customers as part of a paid product.
Research previews and bundled subscription features can meet that minimum; this does not establish mass-market reliability or billion-dollar sales.
Agent includes software that independently performs a multistep task, including research.
Use April 1–28, 2025 as the latest current-month observation window for the ongoing state described as nearly May.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous records establish that OpenAI had no agent capability available as a paid product during the observation window.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Public records establish that an OpenAI agent capability was available to paying customers during the observation window.
